not_reproducible.name: Azure Marketplace image MicrosoftWindowsServer:WindowsServer:2025-Datacenter-g2
not_reproducible.reason: Exists only in Azure with the Azure agent and drivers. A local Hyper-V guest built from other media is a different base.
not_reproducible.owner_action: Decide the accepted deviation for the local base; the reference image stays the hosted runner.

not_reproducible.name: Windows Server 2025 installation media and activation
not_reproducible.reason: Lawful media, edition, key or volume activation and the lab licence are owner decisions. The tooling never downloads, stores or redistributes it.
not_reproducible.owner_action: Owner supplies the Windows Server 2025 Evaluation ISO manually, records its SHA-256, edition and the evaluation licence terms, and places it outside the staging tree.

not_reproducible.name: Windows Updates level of image build 10.0.26100.33438
not_reproducible.reason: Microsoft supersedes updates; the KB list is not recorded upstream.
not_reproducible.owner_action: Record the catalog state at the first lawful fetch or accept a documented update-level deviation.

not_reproducible.name: Visual Studio 2026 Enterprise bootstrapper and stable channel (aka.ms/vs/postGRO-stable/vs_Enterprise.exe)
not_reproducible.reason: Channel stable has no pinned layout and serves the current build, not 18.10.12224.181. Entitlement for a non-GitHub host is not established.
not_reproducible.owner_action: Owner decides the entitlement, then a layout is created once and retained with a recorded hash; a layout creation is a separate approved step.

not_reproducible.name: Visual Studio Marketplace extensions (SSIS, Analysis Services, Reports, Installer Projects, Service Fabric, WiX)
not_reproducible.reason: Downloaded by marketplace item name with no hash and their own terms.
not_reproducible.owner_action: Record licence terms and retain the VSIX files with hashes at the first lawful fetch.

not_reproducible.name: Windows 11 SDK 10.0.26100 and Windows Driver Kit (go.microsoft.com/fwlink redirects)
not_reproducible.reason: Fetched through vendor redirects with an Authenticode check only; Microsoft-licensed.
not_reproducible.owner_action: Resolve the redirect once, retain the installer and record hash and licence.

not_reproducible.name: Vendor latest feeds without a hash source (Cosmos DB emulator, DacFx, SQL OLE DB, Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Selenium, Miniconda, MSYS2, MongoDB, ghcup and others)
not_reproducible.reason: The installed versions are recorded only in the upstream Readme; the feeds serve whatever is current.
not_reproducible.owner_action: Retain the exact installer files at the first lawful fetch with hash, URL chain and licence, or accept a documented drift.

not_reproducible.name: Chocolatey community feed packages
not_reproducible.reason: Package versions resolve at build time from a moving feed.
not_reproducible.owner_action: Pin exact package versions and retain the nupkg files with hashes.

not_reproducible.name: Tool cache version manifests (actions/python-versions, node-versions, go-versions, PyPy)

not_reproducible.owner_action: Snapshot each manifest at a recorded commit, then pin the tool archives it lists by hash.

not_reproducible.owner_action: Decide the accepted deviation for the local base image.

not_reproducible.name: Exact apt package versions listed in the upstream Readme
not_reproducible.reason: The live archive keeps only current versions; availability of a snapshot service for these dates is not verified.
not_reproducible.owner_action: Retain the .deb files or an archive snapshot at the first lawful fetch.
